subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by accepting a larger fixed Control UI history window, or should closure require bounded older-message pagination from `chat.history` offsets?
rationale: Current source proves both the 100-message UI cap and an offset-capable backend, but the docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so maintainers need to own the UX/performance tradeoff.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close only after Control UI can fetch older pages on demand with focused UI and Gateway proof.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Close after a maintainer-approved fixed batch lands with matching render behavior, tests, docs, and real Control UI proof.

options.title: Defer to the canonical scrollback issue
options.body: Treat this issue as evidence for the broader WebChat scrollback work and resolve it only through the canonical pagination path.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close only after Control UI can fetch older pages on demand with focused UI and Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily WebChat product shape and performance policy, and this owner has the broadest relevant WebChat/Gateway history in the local repository history.
